stages.name: harder_terminal_tasks
stages.selection: freeze a stratified sample before running any candidate

stages.name: long_horizon_repository_tasks
stages.selection: freeze task IDs and dataset revision before agent execution; exclude reference-patch previews recorded during preparation
stages.protocol: 50-minute agent phase, model endpoint allowlist, authoritative re-grade by replaying the captured patch in a fresh sandbox

stages.name: hard_long_horizon_tasks
stages.selection: freeze an independent block from the official HARD-51 subset

decision_rules.primary: official verifier pass rate over all attempts; infrastructure failures remain visible
decision_rules.efficiency: compare latency and cost on the same successfully solved tasks; also report all-attempt spend per success
decision_rules.escalation: if quality and efficiency remain indistinguishable, increase independent tasks, repeats, or task difficulty within the shared budget
decision_rules.acceptance: validate development fixes on held-out tasks; preserve all old runs; report tradeoffs and uncertainty
decision_rules.difficulty_controls: freeze each next task block and candidate fingerprints before execution; keep earlier difficulty bands in the cumulative report; a task used to guide fixes becomes development evidence
decision_rules.ceiling: when all agents solve a block, compare common-success latency and cost, then advance to harder or longer tasks if uncertainty still prevents a useful distinction
decision_rules.floor: when all agents fail a block, retain it as diagnostic evidence and add intermediate difficulty tasks to locate the capability boundary
decision_rules.inference: review complete predeclared blocks rather than stopping at a favorable result; distinguish meaningful tradeoffs from a single overall winner
decision_rules.budget_exhaustion: stop new API dispatches; retain unfinished objective and all evidence
